## Simulation Experiment
### p (number of parameters) = 3, n (number of observations) = 200
```{r 200,  echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(NegBinomHMC)
library(MCMCpack)
library(coda)
library(MASS)
set.seed(123)
mcmcnegabin_results <- {}
mcmc_hmc_results <- {}
mcmc_rwm_results <- {}


# Set simulation parameters
n <- 200              # Number of observations
p <- 3                # Number of predictors (including intercept)
beta_true <- c(3, 5, -3)  # True regression coefficients
r_true <- 2           # True dispersion parameter

# Simulate Negative Binomial data
data <- simulate_negbin_data(n, p, beta_true, r_true, seed = 123)
X <- data$X
y <- data$y
df <- data.frame(
  y = y,
  x1 = X[, 2],          # drop the intercept column
  x2 = X[, 3]
)

# Prior hyperparameters
beta_mu <- rep(0, p)
beta_sigma <- rep(1, p)
alpha_r <- 5    # Stronger prior to avoid small r
beta_r <- 2     # Prior mean = 5/2 = 2.5, variance = 5/4 = 1.25

# Fit glm.nb for initial theta
nb_model <- glm.nb(y ~ x1 + x2, data = df)
theta_start <- nb_model$theta

# Run the adaptive HMC sampler
initial_beta <- rep(0, p)  # Initial beta coefficients
initial_beta[3] <- -1
initial_theta <- c(initial_beta, log(2))  # Initial beta, phi = log(2)
start_time <- Sys.time()
result <- hmc_sampler(
  log_post = log_posterior_negbin_log_r,
  grad_log_post = grad_log_posterior_negbin_log_r,
  initial_theta = initial_theta,
  initial_epsilon = 0.005,  # Smaller step size
  L = 20,                   # More leapfrog steps
  n_iter = 10000,
  n_warmup = 5000,
  X = X,
  y = y,
  beta_mu = beta_mu,
  beta_sigma = beta_sigma,
  alpha_r = alpha_r,
  beta_r = beta_r,
  target_accept = 0.8
)
end_time <- Sys.time()
print(paste("HMC runtime:", end_time - start_time))

# Transform phi samples back to r for reporting
r_samples <- exp(result$samples[, p + 1])

# HMC Results
cat("True beta:", beta_true, "\n")
cat("True r:", r_true, "\n")
cat("Estimated beta (mean):", colMeans(result$samples[, 1:p]), "\n")
cat("Estimated r (mean):", mean(r_samples), "\n")
cat("HMC Acceptance rate:", result$acceptance_rate, "\n")
cat("HMC Final epsilon:", result$final_epsilon, "\n")

# HMC Posterior summaries
posterior_samples <- cbind(result$samples[, 1:p], r_samples)
colnames(posterior_samples) <- c(paste0("beta_", 1:p), "r")
summary(posterior_samples)
mcmc_hmc_results <- append(mcmc_hmc_results, list(posterior_samples))

# HMC Effective sample size
mcmc_chain_hmc <- as.mcmc(posterior_samples)
ess_hmc <- effectiveSize(mcmc_chain_hmc)
print("HMC Effective Sample Size:")
print(ess_hmc)

# HMC Length of 95% CI
ci_length_hmc <- apply(posterior_samples, 2, function(x) {
  quantile(x, 0.975) - quantile(x, 0.025)
})
print("HMC Length of 95% CI for each parameter:")
print(ci_length_hmc)

# Run Random Walk Metropolis using MCMCmetrop1R
log_post_wrapper <- function(theta) {
  log_posterior_negbin_log_r(theta, X = X, y = y, 
                             beta_mu = beta_mu, beta_sigma = beta_sigma, 
                             alpha_r = alpha_r, beta_r = beta_r)
}
start_time <- Sys.time()
rwm_draws <- MCMCmetrop1R(
  fun = log_post_wrapper,
  theta.init = initial_theta,  # Same initial values as HMC
  burnin = 5000,
  mcmc = 10000,
  thin = 1,
  tune = 0.1,  # Tuning for proposal SD
  verbose = 0,
  logfun = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)
end_time <- Sys.time()
print(paste("RWM runtime:", end_time - start_time))

# Transform phi samples back to r for RWM
rwm_r_samples <- exp(rwm_draws[, p + 1])

# RWM Results
cat("RWM Estimated beta (mean):", colMeans(rwm_draws[, 1:p]), "\n")
cat("RWM Estimated r (mean):", mean(rwm_r_samples), "\n")
mat <- as.matrix(rwm_draws)
changed <- apply(diff(mat) != 0, 1, any)
accept_rate_rwm <- mean(changed)
cat("RWM Acceptance rate:", accept_rate_rwm, "\n")

# RWM Posterior summaries
rwm_posterior_samples <- cbind(rwm_draws[, 1:p], rwm_r_samples)
colnames(rwm_posterior_samples) <- c(paste0("beta_", 1:p), "r")
summary(rwm_posterior_samples)
mcmc_rwm_results <- append(mcmc_rwm_results, list(rwm_posterior_samples))

# RWM Effective sample size
mcmc_chain_rwm <- as.mcmc(rwm_posterior_samples)
ess_rwm <- effectiveSize(mcmc_chain_rwm)
print("RWM Effective Sample Size:")
print(ess_rwm)

# RWM Length of 95% CI
ci_length_rwm <- apply(rwm_posterior_samples, 2, function(x) {
  quantile(x, 0.975) - quantile(x, 0.025)
})
print("RWM Length of 95% CI for each parameter:")
print(ci_length_rwm)

# Run MCMCnegbin
start_time <- Sys.time()
mcmcnegbin_draws <- MCMCnegbin(
  y ~ x1 + x2,
  data = df,
  burnin = 5000,
  mcmc = 10000,
  thin = 1,
  tune = 0.4,  # Smaller tune to avoid NaN
  b0 = beta_mu,
  B0 = diag(1/beta_sigma^2, p),
  a0 = alpha_r,
  c0 = beta_r,
  theta.start = theta_start,
  control = list(maxit = 1000),
  verbose = 0,
  seed = 123
)
end_time <- Sys.time()
print(paste("MCMCnegbin runtime:", end_time - start_time))

# MCMCnegbin Results
cat("MCMCnegbin Estimated beta (mean):", colMeans(mcmcnegbin_draws), "\n")
mat <- as.matrix(mcmcnegbin_draws)
changed <- apply(diff(mat) != 0, 1, any)
accept_rate_mcmcnegbin <- mean(changed)
cat("MCMCnegbin Acceptance rate:", accept_rate_mcmcnegbin, "\n")

# MCMCnegbin Posterior summaries
mcmcnegbin_posterior_samples <- as.matrix(mcmcnegbin_draws)
colnames(mcmcnegbin_posterior_samples) <- paste0("beta_", 1:p)
summary(mcmcnegbin_posterior_samples)
mcmcnegabin_results <- append(mcmcnegabin_results, list(mcmcnegbin_posterior_samples))

# MCMCnegbin Effective sample size
mcmc_chain_mcmcnegbin <- as.mcmc(mcmcnegbin_posterior_samples)
ess_mcmcnegbin <- effectiveSize(mcmc_chain_mcmcnegbin)
print("MCMCnegbin Effective Sample Size:")
print(ess_mcmcnegbin)
acceptance_rate_mcmcnegbin <- mean(apply(diff(mcmcnegbin_posterior_samples) != 0, 1, any))

# MCMCnegbin Length of 95% CI
ci_length_mcmcnegbin <- apply(mcmcnegbin_posterior_samples, 2, function(x) {
  quantile(x, 0.975) - quantile(x, 0.025)
})
print("MCMCnegbin Length of 95% CI for each parameter:")
print(ci_length_mcmcnegbin)

# Results comparison
df_result <- data.frame(
  method = c("HMC", "RWM", "MCMCnegbin"),
  beta_1 = c(mean(result$samples[, 1]), mean(rwm_draws[, 1]), mean(mcmcnegbin_draws[, 1])),
  ess_beta_1 = c(ess_hmc[1], ess_rwm[1], ess_mcmcnegbin[1]),
  beta_2 = c(mean(result$samples[, 2]), mean(rwm_draws[, 2]), mean(mcmcnegbin_draws[, 2])),
  ess_beta_2 = c(ess_hmc[2], ess_rwm[2], ess_mcmcnegbin[2]),
  beta_3 = c(mean(result$samples[, 3]), mean(rwm_draws[, 3]), mean(mcmcnegbin_draws[, 3])),
  ess_beta_3 = c(ess_hmc[3], ess_rwm[3], ess_mcmcnegbin[3]),
  r = c(mean(r_samples), mean(rwm_r_samples), NA),  # NA for MCMCnegbin
  ess_r = c(ess_hmc[4], ess_rwm[4], NA),           # NA for MCMCnegbin
  acceptance_rate = c(result$acceptance_rate, accept_rate_rwm, accept_rate_mcmcnegbin)
)
print("Comparison of HMC, RWM, and MCMCnegbin:")
print(df_result)

# Trace and density plots
par(mfrow = c(3, 4), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
param_names <- c(paste0("beta_", 1:p), "r")
samples_list <- list(
  hmc = posterior_samples,
  rwm = rwm_posterior_samples,
  mcmcnegbin = mcmcnegbin_posterior_samples
)
true_values <- c(beta_true, r_true)
method_names <- c("HMC", "RWM", "MCMCnegbin")
colors <- c("red", "blue", "green")

for (method_idx in 1:3) {
  samples <- samples_list[[method_idx]]
  method <- method_names[method_idx]
  col <- colors[method_idx]
  max_j <- ifelse(method_idx == 3, 3, 4)  # Only beta_1, beta_2, beta_3 for MCMCnegbin
  
  for (j in 1:max_j) {
    param <- param_names[j]
    true_val <- true_values[j]
    if (method_idx == 3 && j == 4) next  # Skip r for MCMCnegbin
    
    # Trace plot
    plot(samples[, j], type = "l", 
         main = paste(method, "Trace:", param),
         xlab = "Iteration",
         ylab = "Value",
         col = col)
    abline(h = true_val, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
    
    # Density plot
    plot(density(samples[, j]), 
         main = paste(method, "Density:", param),
         xlab = "Value",
         ylab = "Density",
         col = col, lwd = 2)
    abline(v = true_val, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))


```

### p (number of parameters) = 3, n (number of observations) = 2000
```{r 2000, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(123)

# Set simulation parameters
n <- 2000              # Number of observations
p <- 3                # Number of predictors (including intercept)
beta_true <- c(3, 5, -3)  # True regression coefficients
r_true <- 2           # True dispersion parameter

# Simulate Negative Binomial data
data <- simulate_negbin_data(n, p, beta_true, r_true, seed = 123)
X <- data$X
y <- data$y
df <- data.frame(
  y = y,
  x1 = X[, 2],          # drop the intercept column
  x2 = X[, 3]
)

# Prior hyperparameters
beta_mu <- rep(0, p)
beta_sigma <- rep(1, p)
alpha_r <- 5    # Stronger prior to avoid small r
beta_r <- 2     # Prior mean = 5/2 = 2.5, variance = 5/4 = 1.25

# Fit glm.nb for initial theta
nb_model <- glm.nb(y ~ x1 + x2, data = df)
theta_start <- nb_model$theta

# Run the adaptive HMC sampler
initial_beta <- rep(0, p)  # Initial beta coefficients
initial_beta[3] <- -1
initial_theta <- c(initial_beta, log(2))  # Initial beta, phi = log(2)
start_time <- Sys.time()
result <- hmc_sampler(
  log_post = log_posterior_negbin_log_r,
  grad_log_post = grad_log_posterior_negbin_log_r,
  initial_theta = initial_theta,
  initial_epsilon = 0.005,  # Smaller step size
  L = 20,                   # More leapfrog steps
  n_iter = 10000,
  n_warmup = 5000,
  X = X,
  y = y,
  beta_mu = beta_mu,
  beta_sigma = beta_sigma,
  alpha_r = alpha_r,
  beta_r = beta_r,
  target_accept = 0.8
)
end_time <- Sys.time()
print(paste("HMC runtime:", end_time - start_time))

# Transform phi samples back to r for reporting
r_samples <- exp(result$samples[, p + 1])

# HMC Results
cat("True beta:", beta_true, "\n")
cat("True r:", r_true, "\n")
cat("Estimated beta (mean):", colMeans(result$samples[, 1:p]), "\n")
cat("Estimated r (mean):", mean(r_samples), "\n")
cat("HMC Acceptance rate:", result$acceptance_rate, "\n")
cat("HMC Final epsilon:", result$final_epsilon, "\n")

# HMC Posterior summaries
posterior_samples <- cbind(result$samples[, 1:p], r_samples)
colnames(posterior_samples) <- c(paste0("beta_", 1:p), "r")
summary(posterior_samples)
mcmc_hmc_results <- append(mcmc_hmc_results, list(posterior_samples))

# HMC Effective sample size

# HMC Length of 95% CI

  quantile(x, 0.975) - quantile(x, 0.025)
})
print("HMC Length of 95% CI for each parameter:")
print(ci_length_hmc)

# Run Random Walk Metropolis using MCMCmetrop1R
log_post_wrapper <- function(theta) {
  log_posterior_negbin_log_r(theta, X = X, y = y, 
                             beta_mu = beta_mu, beta_sigma = beta_sigma, 
                             alpha_r = alpha_r, beta_r = beta_r)
}
start_time <- Sys.time()
rwm_draws <- MCMCmetrop1R(
  fun = log_post_wrapper,

)
```

## Visualization 
```{r draw-boxplots, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(gridExtra)

create_boxplots <- function(n, hmc_samples, rwm_samples, mcmcnegbin_samples, true_values) {
  # Extract samples for the given n
  hmc_data <- as.data.frame(hmc_samples)
  rwm_data <- as.data.frame(rwm_samples)
  
  # Check if mcmcnegbin_samples is valid (not NA or NULL)
  if (!is.null(mcmcnegbin_samples) && !identical(mcmcnegbin_samples, NA)) {
    mcmcnegbin_data <- as.data.frame(mcmcnegbin_samples)
  } else {
    mcmcnegbin_data <- NULL
  }
  
  # Prepare data for plotting
  param_names <- c("beta_1", "beta_2", "beta_3", "r")
  plots <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:4) {
    param <- param_names[i]
    
    # Combine data for the parameter
    if (i <= 3) {
      # For beta parameters, all methods are available (except MCMCnegbin for n=2000)
      hmc_param <- hmc_data[[param]]
      rwm_param <- rwm_data[[param]]
      if (!is.null(mcmcnegbin_data)) {
        mcmcnegbin_param <- mcmcnegbin_data[[param]]
        data <- data.frame(
          Value = c(hmc_param, rwm_param, mcmcnegbin_param),
          Method = rep(c("HMC", "RWM", "MCMCnegbin"), times = c(length(hmc_param), length(rwm_param), length(mcmcnegbin_param)))
        )
      } else {
        data <- data.frame(
          Value = c(hmc_param, rwm_param),
          Method = rep(c("HMC", "RWM"), times = c(length(hmc_param), length(rwm_param)))
        )
      }
    } else {
      # For r, only HMC and RWM are available
      hmc_param <- hmc_data[[param]]
      rwm_param <- rwm_data[[param]]
      data <- data.frame(
        Value = c(hmc_param, rwm_param),
        Method = rep(c("HMC", "RWM"), times = c(length(hmc_param), length(rwm_param)))
      )
    }
    
    # Create box plot
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = true_values[i], linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste("Parameter:", param, "(n =", n, ")"),
           x = "Method", y = "Value") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("HMC" = "red", "RWM" = "blue", "MCMCnegbin" = "green")) +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    plots[[i]] <- p
  }
  
  # Arrange plots in a grid
  grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = 2, top = paste("Box Plots for n =", n))
}

# True values
true_values <- c(3, 5, -3, 2)  # beta_1, beta_2, beta_3, r

# Generate box plots for each sample size
create_boxplots(200, mcmc_hmc_results[[1]], mcmc_rwm_results[[1]], mcmcnegabin_results[[1]], true_values)
create_boxplots(500, mcmc_hmc_results[[2]], mcmc_rwm_results[[2]], mcmcnegabin_results[[2]], true_values)
create_boxplots(1000, mcmc_hmc_results[[3]], mcmc_rwm_results[[3]], mcmcnegabin_results[[3]], true_values)
create_boxplots(2000, mcmc_hmc_results[[4]], mcmc_rwm_results[[4]], NA, true_values)
```
